description: Retrieve one CuNi catalog entry by its id, e.g. bank, law, check. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use cuni_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the CuNi catalog, e.g. bank, law, check. Get the id list from cuni_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: cuni_get
